crossRefs.note: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from…
He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the…
and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can…
He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked…
for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me…
I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit…
Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

translations.web: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.
translations.bsb: They stopped to go in and lodge in Gibeah. The Levite went in and sat down in the city square, but no one would take them into his home for the night.
translations.kjv: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.
translations.asv: And they turned aside thither, to go in to lodge in Gibeah: and he went in, and sat him down in the street of the city; for there was no man that took them into his house to lodge.
